elements.body: Locum tenens assignment booking, pipeline & contract performance

name.text: Avg Bill Rate vs Pay Rate by Specialty

elements.body: **Data notes:** Estimated Contract Value = Bill Rate × Assignment LOA (days) × 8 hrs/shift. Cancellation reason and facility type are not present in this POC extract, so they aren't broken out below. \~38% of records have no Worksite State captured (mostly on-site "Regular" assignments, not just Telehealth) — shown as *(Not Captured)* rather than hidden.
Specialty × status volume and governed assignment detail

source.statement:
SELECT
  "Main Specialty" AS SPECIALTY,
  COUNT(DISTINCT "Assignment Number") AS BASE_BOOKINGS,
  AVG("Bill Rate") AS AVG_BILL,
  AVG("Pay Rate") AS AVG_PAY,
  AVG("Assignment LOA") AS AVG_LOA,
  SUM("Bill Rate" * "Assignment LOA" * 8) AS BASE_CONTRACT_VALUE,
  SUM("Pay Rate" * "Assignment LOA" * 8) AS BASE_COST,
  SUM("Bill Rate" * "Assignment LOA" * 8)
    - SUM("Pay Rate" * "Assignment LOA" * 8) AS BASE_MARGIN,
  SUM(CASE WHEN "Assignment Status" IN ('Pending', 'Confirmed') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS PIPELINE
FROM BARTONDB.GOLD.ASSIGNMENT_POC_TEST
WHERE "prod_assignment" = 'Yes'
  AND "Assignment Status" NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Withdrawn')
GROUP BY 1
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "Assignment Number") >= 200
ORDER BY BASE_CONTRACT_VALUE DESC
LIMIT 10

columns.formula: [Base Contract Value] * (1 + [Eff Booking Growth %] / 100) * (1 + [Eff Bill Rate %] / 100) * (1 - [Eff Cancel Rate %] / 100)
columns.name: Projected Contract Value

columns.formula: [Base Cost] * (1 + [Eff Booking Growth %] / 100) * (1 + [Eff Pay Rate %] / 100) * (1 - [Eff Cancel Rate %] / 100)
columns.name: Projected Cost

columns.name: Comparison

columns.formula: SumIf([Forecast Book/Projected Margin], [Forecast Book/Scenario] = [ForecastScenario]) - SumIf([Forecast Book/Base Margin], [Forecast Book/Scenario] = [ForecastScenario])
columns.name: Comparison

columns.formula: SumIf([Forecast Book/Projected Contract Value], [Forecast Book/Scenario] = [ForecastScenario]) / SumIf([Forecast Book/Base Contract Value], [Forecast Book/Scenario] = [ForecastScenario]) - 1
columns.name: Revenue Uplift %
